title: SoK: Privacy Attacks on Machine Learning via Explainable AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.10627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning explanations reveal model behavior beyond predictions, creating attack surfaces for model confidentiality and data privacy. We systematize 25 studies that exploit explanations for model extraction, membership inference, and model inversion, treating attribute inference as partial inversion. Existing work is often labeled only black- or white-box, obscuring substantial differences in what explanation signal reaches an adversary. We therefore separate model knowledge from explanation acquisition and identify five paths: target-released, attacker-derived, secondary disclosure, privileged access, and released global artifacts. Across these paths, explanations reduce extraction cost, expose membership signals through explanation statistics, recourse distance, and explanation-guided robustness, and support spatial or algebraic reconstruction of private inputs. translated_title: SoK：通过可解释人工智能对机器学习的隐私攻击
translated_abstract: 机器学习解释揭示了预测之外的模型行为，为模型机密性和数据隐私创造了攻击面。我们系统化了25项利用解释进行模型提取、成员推断和模型反转的研究，并将属性推断视为部分模型反转。现有工作通常仅被标记为黑盒或白盒，这掩盖了解释信号到达攻击者途径上的实质性差异。因此，我们将模型知识与解释获取方式分离，并确定了五种路径：目标方发布、攻击者自衍生、二次披露、特权访问和发布的全局工件。在以上路径中，解释降低了模型提取成本，通过解释统计量、追索距离和解释引导的鲁棒性暴露成员推断信号，并支持对私有输入进行空间或代数重建。我们比较了系统和威胁模型、解释信号、辅助……
tldr: 该论文系统化了25项利用可解释AI实施隐私攻击的研究，将解释获取方式分为五种路径，并揭示了解释如何降低模型提取成本、暴露成员推断信号并支持私有输入重建。
en_tdlr: This paper systematizes 25 studies exploiting explainable AI for privacy attacks, identifies five paths of explanation acquisition, and reveals how explanations reduce model extraction costs, expose membership inference signals, and enable reconstruction of private inputs.
